GOLD - Enum constant in enum class it.polimi.ingsw.model.shared.card.CardType
the gold cards' type.
GoldCard - Class in it.polimi.ingsw.model.shared.card
Represents one of the types of cards in the game that need to be treated in a special manner: a gold card can only be placed if the player has on his board a specific amount of visible resources; additionally, the points awarded for their placement can be both a set amount (just like some resource cards), or they can be calculated based on the number of symbols of a given type present on the player's board.

Class copy-constructor.
GoldCard.CornerBonus - Class in it.polimi.ingsw.model.shared.card
Implements calculate using the amount of corners covered by the gold card as the multiplier that gets applied to the card's base points.
GoldCard.ObjectBonus - Class in it.polimi.ingsw.model.shared.card
Implements calculate using the amount of specified objects found in the gold card owner's board as the multiplier that gets applied to the card's base points.
